author: reek
body: A def declared pure (: Integer, no effect row) whose act block performs Console I/O in a NON-final statement, with a pure final statement. An earlier act-inference loop kept only the last statement's type, so the Console effect vanished before the def-boundary effect-subset check and declared-pure code could perform I/O. The act now carries the union of every statement's effects, so Console surfaces and CDX2031 rejects the undeclared effect.
